name: HeySticky
summary: Personal assistant dashboard: clock, weather, indoor climate, to-dos and notes you add by voice, in English and Vietnamese.
description: HeySticky turns Sticky into an e-paper home dashboard with a big clock, Open-Meteo weather, indoor temperature and humidity, and today's to-dos. Hold the top button and talk: an AI turns what you say into to-dos with deadlines or a note, using your own OpenAI-compatible API key (OpenRouter by default). To-dos and notes are plain Markdown on the microSD card, and a phone page on the Sticky's hotspot lets you set up Wi-Fi and add or edit them. Updates install over Wi-Fi from GitHub Releases.

compatibility.notes: Needs a FAT32 microSD card for to-dos and notes. Voice input needs Wi-Fi and an OpenAI-compatible API key (OpenRouter by default).

assets.previewAlt: HeySticky Home on reTerminal Sticky: greeting, 6:57 PM clock, weather, indoor climate and 3 tasks today

notes.title: Device connection
notes.description: Connect reTerminal Sticky with a USB data cable and use desktop Chrome or Edge.

notes.title: Installation
notes.description: The package writes the bootloader, partition table, OTA selector, and HeySticky application. Later versions install over Wi-Fi from Settings › Software Update.

notes.title: First setup
notes.description: Insert a FAT32 microSD card. With no saved Wi-Fi, Sticky opens Web setup: scan the QR code, open 192.168.4.1, and set your name, city, and Wi-Fi. Add an AI key there to use voice.
